scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run typecheck:compare && npm run lint && npm run test:run && npm run workbench:check
scripts.lint: eslint src node tests scripts workbench
scripts.workbench:prepare: npm -C ../.. run build && npm -C ../../packages/brepjs-families run build && npm -C ../../packages/brepjs-bim run build && npm -C ../../packages/brepjs-viewer run build && npm run build
